# dbdiagramr

dbdiagramr is a web-based tool that generates interactive ER diagrams from any PostgreSQL connection string. No signup, no setup — paste your connection string and visualize your database schema in under 10 seconds.

## Key pages

- Home: https://dbdiagramr.space
- Visualize your database: https://dbdiagramr.space/visualize
- Features: https://dbdiagramr.space#features
- Pricing: https://dbdiagramr.space#pricing

## About

- Generates interactive SVG entity-relationship diagrams from live PostgreSQL schemas
- Supports pan, zoom, and hover-to-trace table relationships
- Exports diagrams as SVG or PNG
- Works with cloud databases: Supabase, Neon, Railway
- Uses Transaction pooler (port 6543) for serverless platform compatibility
- Connection strings are never stored — introspected and discarded immediately
- Built with Next.js, PostgreSQL, and Tailwind CSS
